_comment: B1 level exam. Format: app/content/exams/README.md. Question ids are stable.

grammar.q: I ___ my passport. I can't find it anywhere.
We've known each other ___ 2015.
answer: since

grammar.q: I have visited Rome two years ago.
answer: I visited Rome two years ago.

grammar.q: The client has paid the invoice.
answer: The client hasn't paid the invoice yet.
The client hasn't yet paid the invoice.
grammar.explain_tr: Olumsuz present perfect: [en:hasn't] + V3; [en:yet] genelde cümlenin sonuna gelir.

grammar.q: The meeting finished a few minutes ago.
answer: The meeting has just finished.
The meeting's just finished.
grammar.explain_tr: Az önce olan bir şey için [en:has/have] + [en:just] + V3 kullanılır; [en:ago] present perfect ile kullanılmaz.

answer: Have you ever given a presentation in English?

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:

Since Monday we haven't heard from the supplier.
grammar.explain_tr: Başlangıç noktası [en:since] ile verilir ve present perfect kullanılır.

grammar.q: We ___ the contract last Friday.
grammar.explain_tr: Belli bir geçmiş zaman ([en:last Friday]) varsa past simple kullanılır.

grammar.q: I ___ dinner when the lights went out.
While they ___ the house, they found an old letter. (clean)
answer: were cleaning

grammar.q: When I was arriving at the station, the train left.
answer: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left.
When I arrived at the station, the train had left.
When I arrived at the station, the train left.

grammar.q: You were working on the budget at nine o'clock.
answer: Were you working on the budget at nine o'clock?
Were you working on the budget at 9 o'clock?

grammar.q: I was checking the figures. I found a serious mistake.
answer: While I was checking the figures, I found a serious mistake.
I found a serious mistake while I was checking the figures.
While checking the figures, I found a serious mistake.
I found a serious mistake while checking the figures.
grammar.explain_tr: Süren eylem [en:while] + past continuous ile, araya giren olay past simple ile anlatılır.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: The printer stopped working while I was printing the contracts.
While I was printing the contracts, the printer stopped working.
grammar.explain_tr: Uzun süren eylem past continuous, araya giren kısa olay past simple olur.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: What were you doing when the client arrived?
When the client arrived, what were you doing?
grammar.explain_tr: Bir olay olduğu anda süren eylemi sormak için [en:What were you doing…?] kullanılır.

grammar.q: Sorry, I didn't answer your call because I was drive.
answer: Sorry, I didn't answer your call because I was driving.

I don't mind ___ late tonight. (work)
answer: working

He's thinking about changing his job.

answer: I have stopped eating fast food.

grammar.q: Don't forget to call the bank.
answer: Remember to call the bank.

Remember to call the bank, please.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: We're looking forward to working with your team.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:look forward to]'daki [en:to] bir edattır, ardından fiil[en:-ing] gelir.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: She keeps forgetting to update the spreadsheet.

grammar.q: Have you considered ___ for the manager position?
You ___ bring food. Lunch is included.

answer: You should call her today.

grammar.q: We must finish the report by Friday.
answer: We had to finish the report by Friday.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:must]'ın geçmiş hâli yoktur; geçmişteki zorunluluk için [en:had to] kullanılır.

grammar.q: It's a good idea to check the contract carefully.
answer: You should check the contract carefully.
You should carefully check the contract.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: Visitors mustn't enter the warehouse without a helmet.
Without a helmet visitors mustn't enter the warehouse.
grammar.explain_tr: Yasak bildirmek için [en:mustn't] + yalın fiil kullanılır.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: Did you have to work last weekend?
Last weekend did you have to work?
grammar.explain_tr: Geçmişteki zorunluluğu sormak: [en:Did] + özne + [en:have to] + fiil.

grammar.q: You ___ ask Deniz for the password. She's the only person who knows it.
grammar.explain_tr: Başka yol olmadığı için zorunluluk var: [en:have to].

grammar.q: If I ___ more money, I would buy a bigger flat.
If you ___ now, you'll catch the train. (leave)
answer: leave

grammar.q: I'll call you when I will get home.
answer: I'll call you when I get home.
I will call you when I get home.
grammar.explain_tr: [en:when] ile başlayan zaman cümlesinde gelecek için [en:will] değil present simple kullanılır.

grammar.q: If you don't sign the form, we can't start the project.
answer: Unless you sign the form, we can't start the project.
We can't start the project unless you sign the form.

grammar.q: If we hire more people, we will finish on time.
answer: If we hired more people, we would finish on time.
If we hired more people, we'd finish on time.
We would finish on time if we hired more people.
We'd finish on time if we hired more people.
grammar.explain_tr: Second conditional: [en:If] + past simple, [en:would] + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: If the client agrees, we'll start on Monday.
We'll start on Monday if the client agrees.
grammar.explain_tr: First conditional: [en:If] + present simple, [en:will] + fiil; iki bölümün yeri değişebilir.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: If we had a bigger budget, we'd hire another designer.
We'd hire another designer if we had a bigger budget.
grammar.explain_tr: Hayalî durum: [en:If] + past simple, [en:'d] ([en:would]) + yalın fiil.

grammar.q: We'll discuss the details when the manager ___ back from holiday. (come)
answer: comes
has come
grammar.explain_tr: [en:when] ile başlayan zaman cümlesinde gelecek için [en:will] değil present simple kullanılır.

grammar.q: The results ___ next week.
This song was ___ by a Turkish band. (write)
answer: written

grammar.q: The package delivered yesterday.
answer: The package was delivered yesterday.

grammar.q: They clean the offices every evening.

grammar.q: Our designer created the new logo.
answer: The new logo was created by our designer.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: The parcels are delivered by a local company.
Are the parcels delivered by a local company?
grammar.explain_tr: Edilgen yapı: [en:are] + V3; işi yapan [en:by] ile verilir.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:
answer: When was the order sent to the customer?
grammar.explain_tr: Edilgen soru: soru kelimesi + [en:was] + özne + V3.

grammar.q: This report is wrote every month by the sales team.
answer: This report is written every month by the sales team.
This report is written by the sales team every month.

grammar.q: That's the colleague ___ helped me with the project.
This is the town ___ my father was born.
answer: where

grammar.q: The phone that I bought it last week is broken.
answer: The phone that I bought last week is broken.
The phone I bought last week is broken.
The phone which I bought last week is broken.

grammar.instruction_tr: [en:who] ya da [en:that] ile tek cümle yap
grammar.q: We hired an engineer. He used to work in Germany.
answer: We hired an engineer who used to work in Germany.
We hired an engineer that used to work in Germany.
grammar.explain_tr: İnsanlar için [en:who] ya da [en:that] kullanılır; [en:He] artık tekrar yazılmaz.

grammar.q: I spoke to a customer. His order was lost.

I spoke to a customer whose order had been lost.

grammar.q: Kelimeleri doğru sıraya koy:

dictation.text: I've worked for this company since I graduated from university.
If we finish the project early, the client will give us a bonus.
The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.
She was talking to a customer when the system suddenly stopped working.
We don't have to wear suits, but we should look professional.
The new products were shown to our customers at the trade fair.
The colleague who trained me last year has moved to another department.
I used to drive to work, but now I take the train.

comprehension.text: Good morning, everyone. The aim of today's meeting is to discuss the new office. As you know, we've grown a lot this year, and the current office is too small. We've looked at two options. The first one is in the city centre. It's more expensive, but it's easier to get to by metro. The second one is cheaper and bigger, but it's outside the city. I'd like to hear your opinions before we make a decision on Friday.

options: Şirket büyüdü ve ofis küçük kaldı

questions.q_tr: Şehir merkezindeki seçenek için hangisi doğru?
options: Metroyla ulaşımı daha kolay ama daha pahalı

comprehension.text: When I was younger, I used to work in a bank. I was earning good money, but I wasn't happy. One day, while I was waiting for a client, I started reading about web design. I decided to take an online course, and two years later I left the bank. I've been a freelance designer for five years now, and I've never regretted it.

questions.q_tr: Konuşan kişi eskiden ne iş yapıyordu?

comprehension.text: Hello, this is Kerem from Delta Office Supplies. I'm calling about your order for the new printers. Unfortunately, the printers weren't delivered to our warehouse on Monday because there was a problem at the factory. They will arrive at our warehouse on Wednesday, so we can deliver them to your office on Friday. If Friday isn't convenient for you, please call me back on oh five three two, four one six, two two eight nine. I'm in the office until five thirty. Sorry again for the delay.

questions.q_tr: Yazıcılar ofise hangi gün teslim edilecek?

comprehension.text: When I started my first job, I used to arrive at the office very early because I was worried about being late. One morning, while I was making coffee in the kitchen, the director came in. She asked me which department I worked in. I was so nervous that I forgot the name of my team! She laughed and told me not to worry. Today she's my manager, and we often laugh about that morning.

questions.q_tr: Konuşan kişi ilk işinde ofise neden erken gelirdi?
Direktör mutfağa girdiğinde konuşan kişi ne yapıyordu?

comprehension.text: Hi everyone, just a quick update about the new security system. From next Monday, all visitors must be registered at reception, and they have to wear a visitor card at all times. You don't have to register colleagues from our other offices, because they already have ID cards. Please remember that the doors on the third floor are locked at seven in the evening. If you need to stay later, you should tell the security team before six.

questions.q_tr: Diğer ofislerden gelen çalışma arkadaşları için hangisi doğru?
Akşam yediden sonra ofiste kalması gereken biri ne yapmalı?
options: Saat altıdan önce güvenlik ekibine haber vermeli

speaking.question_en: Tell me about yourself: what do you do, how long have you done it, and what have you learned in your job?
speaking.instruction_tr: Kendini bir iş görüşmesindeki gibi tanıt: ne iş yapıyorsun, ne kadar süredir, işinde neler öğrendin (present perfect).
speaking.focus: the present perfect and past simple for experience

speaking.question_en: Your company wants everyone to work from the office five days a week. What do you think? Give your opinion and your reasons.
speaking.instruction_tr: Şirketin herkesin haftada beş gün ofisten çalışmasını istiyor. Fikrini gerekçeleriyle söyle; katılmıyorsan kibarca belirt.
speaking.focus: giving opinions, agreeing and disagreeing politely

speaking.question_en: What would you do if you could change one thing about your job or your city?
speaking.instruction_tr: İşinde ya da şehrinde bir şeyi değiştirebilseydin ne yapardın? (second conditional)

speaking.question_en: Tell me about a time when something went wrong at work or at school. What were you doing when it happened, and what did you do next?
speaking.instruction_tr: İşte ya da okulda bir şeylerin ters gittiği bir anını anlat: o sırada ne yapıyordun, sonra ne yaptın? (past continuous ve past simple)
speaking.focus: the past continuous and past simple for telling a story

speaking.question_en: How is your life or your job different from ten years ago? What did you use to do that you don't do now?
speaking.instruction_tr: Hayatın ya da işin on yıl öncesine göre nasıl değişti? Eskiden yapıp artık yapmadığın şeyleri anlat ([en:used to]).
speaking.focus: used to for past habits and states

speaking.question_en: A new colleague is starting in your team next week. What are the rules in your office, and what advice would you give them?
speaking.instruction_tr: Gelecek hafta ekibine yeni bir çalışma arkadaşı katılıyor. Ofisinizdeki kuralları anlat ve ona tavsiyeler ver ([en:must], [en:have to], [en:don't have to], [en:should]).
speaking.focus: must, have to, don't have to and should for rules and advice

writing.instruction_tr: Yöneticine bir e-posta yaz: geçen hafta ekipte yaşanan bir sorunu (ör. bir gecikme ya da hata) anlat, ne olduğunu ve nasıl çözdüğünüzü açıkla, gelecekte tekrar olmaması için bir öneri sun. En az 90 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to your manager: describe a problem your team had last week (for example a delay or a mistake), explain what happened and how you solved it, and suggest what you should do so it doesn't happen again.
writing.focus: past simple and past continuous, the passive, should, giving suggestions in a work email

writing.instruction_tr: Toplantıya katılamayan bir çalışma arkadaşına e-posta yaz: toplantıda kimin ne söylediğini aktar, hangi kararların alındığını açıkla ve ondan ne yapmasının istendiğini belirt. En az 90 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to a colleague who missed a meeting: report what people said, explain what was decided, and tell them what they have been asked to do.
writing.focus: reported speech (said, told, asked), the passive, a clear work email

writing.instruction_tr: Bir tedarikçiye şikâyet e-postası yaz: siparişinde ne sorun olduğunu anlat (ör. geç geldi, bazı ürünler eksik ya da hasarlıydı), bunun işini nasıl etkilediğini açıkla ve onlardan ne yapmalarını istediğini kibarca belirt. En az 90 kelime.
writing.prompt_en: Write a complaint email to a supplier: explain what was wrong with your order (for example it arrived late, or some items were missing or damaged), say how this affected your work, and politely say what you would like them to do.
writing.focus: the passive, past simple and past continuous, the first conditional, polite requests (Could you…, I would like…)
